text:
Maya Lin: Zenith ops asked what exact CSVs we need to feed into Redwood's marketplace cost model. Need a short vendor-friendly checklist + tiny example rows they can copy.
Omar Haddad: Minimal fields: sku_id, region, date(UTC), total_hours, reserved_hours, spot_hours, avg_spot_price_usd, evictions_count.
Cassie Park (Finance): Also include commit terms CSV: sku_id, commit_tenor_months, reserved_hourly_usd, min_commit_hours, volume_tier_thresholds, volume_tier_discount_pct, credit_latency_days, tax_inclusive(boolean).
Ryan (Sales): Add burst_rate_multiplier (if bursts bill > base) and billing_granularity (hour/min). Vendors care about that when quoting.
Maya Lin: Eviction detail schema please: eviction_timestamp_iso, duration_minutes, reason_code. Ask for UTC.
Vendor Integration Bot: Sample availability rows attached:
```
sku_id,region,date,total_hours,reserved_hours,spot_hours,evictions_count,avg_spot_price_usd
zenith-gpu-a100,us-west-2,2026-03-10,24,480,3300,1,0.73
zenith-gpu-a100,us-west-2,2026-03-11,24,480,3280,0,0.70
```
Maya Lin: Also request 14-day window and preferred CSV encoding: UTF-8, comma.
Cassie Park (Finance): Deadline: EOD Thursday so finance can map to P&L for next pricing sync. Please ask vendors to confirm refund/credit policy for evictions too.
Omar Haddad: I'll attach a second sample commit table:
```
sku_id,commit_tenor_months,reserved_hourly_usd,min_commit_hours,volume_tier_1_threshold,volume_tier_1_discount_pct,credit_latency_days,burst_rate_multiplier
zenith-gpu-a100,12,2.40,1000,10000,7,14,1.5
```
Maya Lin: Draft to send: "Hi Zenith ops 12 quick onboarding ask: please share a 14-day sample (UTC) of per-region daily availability and a commitment-terms CSV using the attached headers. Include eviction event examples and your eviction credit policy (including credit latency). Preferred format: CSV UTF-8. Could you provide by EOD Thursday? Happy to take a short call. Thanks 12 Maya on Partnerships."
Ryan (Sales): I'll offer a follow-up 20-min call in the email.
Vendor Integration Bot: File uploaded: zenith-mini-sample.csv (2 rows)
Maya Lin: Action items: Omar attach commit sample, Cassie prep finance mapping, Ryan include calendly link. Target send: today by 11:30am PT :thumbsup:
